newsitem.title: USA: Integrated to acquire Community Care.
newsitem.headline: Integrated to acquire Community Care.

text.p: Integrated Health Services Inc said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Community Care of America Inc for about $94 million, including the assumption of Community's debt and other financial obligations.
The company said it will start a tender offer of $4.00 per share in cash for all outstanding shares of Community's common stock. It expects to begin its offer on August 7.
The company said this offer would be followed by a $4.00 per share cash merger to acquire any shares not previously tendered.
Integrated said it expects the deal to be accretive to earnings and earnings per share.
The company said the cash tender offer is subject to at least a majority of the fully diluted shares of Community being tendered, as well as the receipt of the required regulatory approvals.
Community has about 7.6 million shares outstanding and about 10.7 million shares on a fully diluted basis.
Integrated said stockholders owning about 2.9 million shares of Community common stock have agreed to tender their shares.
In addition, Integrated owns warrants exercisable for about 1.2 million shares.
As a result of the deal, Community Care of America would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Integrated Health Services.
Integrated said it expects to complete the deal within 90 days.
Community Care of America provides healthcare services in rural markets. Its operations include 54 long-term care facilities, one physician practice, and one outpatient rehabilitation center.
